_note: Which walk-on roles a place has in it. A place's tags (places.gameplay.json) name the roles that could be standing there, and features/cast/ambientPeople.ts picks at most two of them, and which face each one is, from the campaign and the place alone. The narrator is TOLD who they are before it writes (the context's 'Also here' line), so the picture is no longer chosen after the prose from nothing but a role. House rule: no book behind it. Every walk-on role in flavor-art.json must be reachable from at least one tag, and every tag must be a real place tag; ambientPeople.test.ts holds both.
_sellers: Roles that are somebody behind a counter. A place that already has a named keeper (place-shops.json) is staffed by that keeper, so these are left out there: two people behind one counter is the narrator inventing the second.
_nouns: What a sentence calls each role, so features/narration/narratorChecks.ts can hold a pronoun to the face the narrator was told about ('the bartender ... she'). A noun the narrator might use for somebody else in the room is left out. Every role has at least one; ambientPeople.test.ts holds it.
